tago-bus-alerts v1.0.0

- Initial release: Schedule and manage bus arrival alerts using Korea TAGO OpenAPI and Clawdbot cron.
- Register personalized weekday/weekend bus alerts by stop name and routes; receive automatic DM notifications.
- Requires Clawdbot Gateway, Clawdbot cron, and a configured TAGO API key.
- Includes step-by-step setup, alert management commands (add, list, delete, test), and interactive registration helper.
- DM-only delivery ensures privacy; safety checks for ambiguous stops and destructive actions are built-in.
